hook: Your walk to this castle island can be cut off by the sea.
title: The Island the Sea Cuts Off Twice a Day
description:
Mont Saint-Michel in France is a tidal island. At high tide the sea cuts it off from the mainland. At low tide, you can walk across the sands.

#Shorts #Geography #France
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
